title: Unclear error message for invalid access request action type
description: When agent attempts to use an invalid action type in an access request, the error message references 'bind' or 'grant' but does not explain which one to use or when.
reproduction_steps: Attempt to create an access request with action='create'
expected_behavior: Error message should clearly indicate valid action types and provide guidance on which to use for the current operation.
actual_behavior: Exit code 1 with error: "Input should be 'bind' or 'grant'" — no context about when to use each.
evidence: Exit code 1: error: http 422: {"detail":[{"type":"literal_error","loc":["body","items",0,"action"],"msg":"Input should be 'bind' or 'grant'","input":"create"

title: Broker endpoint not discoverable or documented in error messages
description: Agent attempted to make proxied requests to localhost:8100 which failed with connection refused. The correct broker endpoint was not clearly communicated in error messages or available via a discovery command.
reproduction_steps: Attempt to make proxied request without first discovering broker endpoint
expected_behavior: Error message should indicate the correct broker endpoint, or a discovery command should be available to find it.
actual_behavior: Connection refused on localhost:8100; agent had to discover endpoint through trial and error.
evidence: Exit code 1: {"error": "Get \"http://localhost:8100/get\": dial tcp [::1]:8100: connect: connection refused"
